_comment: Actual printed ChArUco board dimensions. Print scaled below nominal; these corrected sizes are used for calibration so reconstruction is metrically correct. Measured 2026-08-13.
_scale_note: Best estimate from 3 careful single-square reads (mean 28.52 mm) -> scale 0.9508. 100mm ruler implied ~28.06 mm (~1.5% lower); gap is hand-measurement noise. Rod accuracy-check will confirm/back-correct absolute scale empirically.
